name: The Shot You Set Up Yesterday

description.value:
Cast 1 hour

Frequency once per day

Requirement You can observe or reliably describe the location an encounter will occur in.

The fight started when you decided it did, not when the shooting began.

Prepare a firing position in advance. If an encounter begins there within the next 24 hours, you act on the first round before any creature that has not already detected you, your first Strike of that encounter is against an off-guard target, and that Strike may be a Called Shot for 1 action instead of 2.

cinderfall.incomplete: (Called Shot dependency for the last clause) — the untracked 24-hour setup condition also has no roll-option hook. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
